description: Canonical Decant Please! design tokens — mirrors the @theme block in frontend/src/app/globals.css and CLAUDE.md §3. A future non-web client (e.g. Flutter ThemeData) translates THIS file; if a value changes, change it in globals.css and here in the same commit. The pine-50…950 ramp (Step 34 PR-3b) is pine's hue at raised lightness, muted to a teal-green, for the dark Studio admin panel; it is mirrored a THIRD time in backend StudioPanelProvider's primary color, so those three change together.
